messages:
anika: FYI I hit a pretty reproducible parser fail in the node samplekit when a tool call retries due to a short-lived auth 401. Looks like assembly doubles up chunks and the schema validator chokes.
anika: Quick repro: make a tool/fncall with jsonMode on, trigger a retry mid-stream (401), SDK helper replays buffer -> returns an array containing the same object twice. Validator wanted a single object.

anika: Small log snippet:
```
transport: frame1 = {\"user\":\"u1\", \"res\": {\"id\":123}}
retry: auth refresh -> replay buffered frame1
assembly: frames -> [ {\"user\":\"u1\", \"res\":{\"id\":123}} ]
final-assembly: [ {\"user\":\"u1\", \"res\":{\"id\":123}} ]
validator: expected OBJECT but got ARRAY
```

maria: Is this only Node? We have parity tests but maybe they only hit non-retry paths.
asanjay: (typo correction) sanjay: Which helper version?
anika: node-sdk@1.10.2 with samplekit adapter. A customer hit it during onboarding sampleapp run; python helper returns a single object in the same scenario.

maria: Sounds like the stream-assembler treats "multiple frames" as an array regardless of logical tool output. If a retry replays frames identical to earlier frames, assembler doesn't dedupe.

leo: Two options: 1) de-dup identical frames during assembly, 2) if schema says top-level is object, collapse single-length arrays to object at boundary. Both have tradeoffs (silently coercing types vs preserving raw stream).

anika: For immediate unblock, collapsing single-element arrays into object when jsonMode + schema=OBJECT would be safest. We'll mention the behavior in onboarding docs until we fix upstream.

maria: I'll add a unit test that simulates replays and a small e2e check of sampleapp. Also add a parity test comparing Node/Py under the same simulated transport.

leo: I'll draft the PR: change assembly.normalizeFrames() to handle single-element arrays when expectedType==object, and add a flag strictJsonMode to opt-in to rejecting coercions.

devex-bot: Ticket created DX-1178: "node-samplekit: chunk replay leads to array vs object mismatch in jsonMode". Added labels: dx, flaky-test, onboarding.

anika: Thanks — attaching a tiny repro repo to the ticket (recorded frames + minimal node harness). This was breaking two customer demos, so would love a hotfix. :pray:

maria: Also adding a CI fuzz job that runs both SDKs against randomized chunk sequences (retries, dupes, partial frames) to catch similar edgecases.

sanjay: Good call. Can we also emit an assembly-debug log wedge for samplekit when debug=true so SRE/support can triage without asking for full traces?

leo: Yep, adding conditional verbose logs to the assembly layer. Will include sample output in PR description.

anika: Great, thanks all :thumbsup:
